    [INPUTS]
    [END_INPUTS]

ImageProcessor.load_image:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Loads an image from the given file path and assigns it to the instance attribute self.image." load_image]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> image_path </REF>: str "Path to the image file to open."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Open the image file located at image_path using Image.open and assign the resulting Image object to self.image. RESULT self.image]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
ImageProcessor.save_image:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Saves the image to the given file path only if self.image is truthy." save_image]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> save_path </REF>: str "Destination file path for the saved image."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Evaluate whether self.image is truthy (not None, False, 0, or empty). RESULT has_image]
            [COMMAND If has_image is true, call self.image.save(save_path) to save the image to save_path. RESULT save_result]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: self.image is falsy (None, False, 0, or empty)]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Skip the save operation and continue execution after the if block. RESULT None]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
ImageProcessor.resize_image:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Resizes the stored image to the specified width and height if an image is currently present." resize_image]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> width </REF>: int "Target width for the resized image."
        <REF> height </REF>: int "Target height for the resized image."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Evaluate the truthiness of self.image to determine whether an image is currently present and non-empty. RESULT image_present]
            [COMMAND If image_present is true, call self.image.resize with the tuple (width, height) and assign the returned resized image back to self.image; otherwise, perform no action and continue. RESULT self.image]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
ImageProcessor.rotate_image:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Rotates the image stored on the object by the specified number of degrees if an image is present; otherwise it leaves the image unchanged." rotate_image]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> degrees </REF>: int or float "Rotation angle in degrees to apply to the image."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Evaluate whether self.image is truthy; if it is falsy, skip the rotation and keep self.image unchanged. RESULT image_truthiness]
            [COMMAND Inside the if self.image truthy branch, call self.image.rotate(degrees) and assign the rotated result back to self.image. RESULT self.image]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
ImageProcessor.adjust_brightness:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Adjusts the brightness of the stored image by applying the given factor to a PIL ImageEnhance.Brightness enhancer only when an image exists." adjust_brightness]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> factor </REF>: float "Brightness adjustment factor passed to ImageEnhance.enhance(); higher values brighten the image, while lower values darken it."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Evaluate whether self.image is truthy (exists and is not None or another falsy value). RESULT image_present]
            [COMMAND When image_present is true, construct an ImageEnhance.Brightness enhancer from self.image. RESULT enhancer]
            [COMMAND Within the if self.image branch, call enhancer.enhance(factor) and assign the returned enhanced image to self.image. RESULT self.image]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: self.image is falsy (for example, None or an object whose boolean evaluation is False)]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Leave self.image unchanged and continue without applying any brightness adjustment. RESULT self.image]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
